recipe.name: Chocolate Caramel Crispy
recipe.description: No-bake squares of crisp rice cereal bound with melted chocolate caramel bars and butter, finished with a smooth milk chocolate layer.
steps: Grease an 8 x 8 inch (20 x 20 cm) baking tin and line it with parchment paper.
Chop the caramel nougat bars into small pieces.
Put the chopped bars and the butter in a heatproof bowl over a saucepan of gently simmering water. Keep the bowl's base clear of the water.
Whisk as the mixture melts until smooth with no lumps.
Tip the melted mixture over the crisp rice cereal in a large bowl. Fold until the cereal is evenly coated.
Press the mixture into the tin until flat and compact, then set it aside.
Melt the milk chocolate until smooth, in the microwave in short bursts, stirring between each, or in a bowl over simmering water.
Spread the chocolate over the top in an even layer.
Leave somewhere cool until the chocolate is hard and the bars are firm.
You nailed it! Grab a plate and dig in.
